body:
## Why

The repository configuration in pyproject.toml defines ruff exclusion rules via extend-exclude = ["research-program/artifacts"] at line 64, but tool.black at lines 102-105 lacks an equivalent exclusion rule. Consequently, running black --check . evaluates machine-generated, unformatted Python scripts published under research-program/artifacts (such as research-program/artifacts/audits/Fine-Art-Archive-2026-09-05-resume/finalize.py). This causes CI formatting checks in Python CI / lint-format to fail on main with exit code 1. Adding extend-exclude = 'research-program/artifacts' under tool.black ensures that published research artifacts do not trigger false-positive CI format gate failures.

## Scope

- Update pyproject.toml to include extend-exclude = 'research-program/artifacts' under tool.black.
- Add regression coverage in tests/test_repo_hygiene.py verifying pyproject.toml excludes research-program/artifacts across formatting tools.

## Non-Goals

- Modifying black line-length or target-version settings in pyproject.toml.
- Manually reformatting machine-owned files under research-program/.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: reformatting artifact scripts manually without adding the pyproject.toml black configuration rule is a failure of this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add extend-exclude = 'research-program/artifacts' to tool.black in pyproject.toml
- [ ] Add a regression test in tests/test_repo_hygiene.py asserting pyproject.toml tool.black contains the extend-exclude setting

## Acceptance Criteria

- `black --check .` executes and passes with exit code 0 on the repository root.
- `pytest tests/test_repo_hygiene.py` passes all assertions.
- Deliberate-break demonstration: removing extend-exclude from tool.black in pyproject.toml causes `black --check .` to fail with exit code 1 when unformatted artifact files exist, and reverting restores pass.

## Implementation Notes

References: Code/Audits/Ready/2026-09-07-00-repo-map.md.
Ensure pyproject.toml remains valid TOML parseable by tomllib.
title: [P1] Exclude research-program artifacts from black formatting in pyproject.toml
